title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1970-11-07
taper: Ken Leigh, Jack Toner and Marty Weinberg

ai_review.summary: Audience tape with uneven levels yet captures a magical Capitol Theater show highlighted by an epic Truckin > drums > Other One jam.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience source that suffers from dramatic volume swings, occasional conversational bleed and a generally "cloudy" sound, though listeners note it improves with EQ. Musically the performance shines – the acoustic set is praised, and the electric set delivers a standout Truckin > drums > Other One sequence that rolls into a sweet Casey Jones, plus early‑stage development of the iconic "gone, gone, gone" phrasing in I Know You Rider.

ai_rating.rationale: Show receives strong praise (multiple 5‑star comments) while recording quality is split between rave and critical remarks, leading to a solid combined score around 4.0.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Volume levels bounce dramatically, causing listeners to constantly adjust gain; conversation bleed is audible; some describe the sound as "cloudy" or muffled, though others claim the tape sounds amazing after proper EQ.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic set opens the show and is well‑received; electric set builds momentum with a long Truckin > drums > Other One jam (over 16 minutes) that segues into Casey Jones, showcasing dynamic pacing and strong improvisational flow.

band_member_comments.Drums: A notably long drum segment (~16 min) leading into The Other One is highlighted as a centerpiece of the electric set.
